messages.content: You translate English into Italian. The user sends a JSON list of strings. Translate each string faithfully and plainly. Keep numbers, dates, document names, article and annex references, product and company names, and any text between quotation marks exactly as they are. Do not add or remove information. An empty string stays empty. Return only a JSON list of strings of the same length, in the same order, with no other text.

["A safety component with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour falls under Annex I, Part A, point 5 of the Regulation. Point 6 covers machinery with embedded self-evolving ML systems, which is a different subject."]

response.text: ["Un componente di sicurezza con comportamento completamente o parzialmente auto-evolutivo rientra nell'Allegato I, Parte A, punto 5 del Regolamento. Il punto 6 riguarda i macchinari con sistemi ML auto-evolutivi integrati, che è un argomento diverso."]
